documents.text: In BM25 the parameter b scales term frequency by the ratio of document length to the average length, so long documents do not win just because they repeat words.
BM25 is the default ranking function in Lucene and Elasticsearch.
Pivoted length normalization corrects the bias of cosine normalization toward short documents.
Test collections such as TREC pair documents and topics with human relevance judgments, so precision, recall and nDCG can be computed for any system.
Online experiments compare two rankers by showing each to a share of users and measuring clicks and abandonment.
Query logs reveal which searches are most frequent and when traffic peaks during the day.
Did-you-mean suggestions pick dictionary words within a small edit distance of a mistyped query term and rank them by frequency.
Autocomplete predicts the rest of a query from popular prefixes typed by other users.
Dense retrievers encode queries and passages into vectors with a transformer and rank by cosine similarity, matching paraphrases that share no words.
Approximate nearest neighbour indexes such as HNSW make vector search fast over millions of items.
Latent semantic indexing applies singular value decomposition to the term-document matrix to uncover hidden topics.
Postings lists are stored as gaps between document ids and encoded with variable-byte or Elias-gamma codes, shrinking the index several times.
An inverted index maps each term to the list of documents that contain it.
Image compression formats such as JPEG discard detail that the eye barely notices.
A web crawler downloads pages by following links from a set of seed URLs.
A Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra-virgin olive oil reduced major cardiovascular events, including heart attacks and strokes, by about 30 percent in a large Spanish trial.
Monounsaturated fats such as those in olive oil lower LDL cholesterol, a major risk factor for coronary heart disease.
Olive oil has been part of Mediterranean cooking for thousands of years, and its flavour depends on the olive variety and the harvest.
A heart attack happens when blood flow to part of the heart muscle is blocked, usually by a clot in a coronary artery; call emergency services if chest pain spreads to the arm or jaw.
Replacing butter with plant oils rich in unsaturated fat is linked to fewer cardiac events in long-term cohort studies.
Vitamin D helps the gut absorb calcium, and in older adults with low levels, supplements taken with calcium modestly reduce the risk of hip fractures.
Sunlight on the skin lets the body make cholecalciferol, which is needed to keep the skeleton strong.
Calcium-rich foods include milk, yogurt, sardines and leafy greens.
Most adults need seven to nine hours of sleep per night; regularly sleeping less than seven hours is associated with weight gain, high blood pressure and poorer concentration.
Insomnia is difficulty falling or staying asleep, and cognitive behavioural therapy is the recommended first treatment.
Teenagers' body clocks shift later, so early school start times leave many of them chronically short of rest.
Brisk walking for 150 minutes a week lowers the risk of heart disease and type 2 diabetes and helps older adults stay independent.
In seniors, daily physical activity such as strolling or gardening slows the loss of muscle mass and improves balance, reducing falls.
Bacteria in dental plaque turn the sugar in soft drinks into acid that dissolves enamel, so frequent sipping of sweetened beverages raises the risk of cavities.
Fluoride toothpaste strengthens enamel and helps prevent caries.
Low-cost index funds and fractional shares let beginners invest small amounts each month and spread risk across many companies.
Automatic monthly transfers into a brokerage account build the habit of putting money aside, even if it is only a few dollars.
Stock prices move with company earnings, interest rates and investor sentiment.
The avalanche method pays the card with the highest interest rate first, while the snowball method clears the smallest balance first for motivation.
Moving a balance to a card with a 0% introductory rate can cut interest costs while you repay the principal.
Your credit score depends on payment history, utilization and the length of your credit history.
Financial planners usually suggest saving three to six months of essential expenses in an easily accessible account for emergencies.
A rainy-day cushion of cash protects you from borrowing when the car breaks down or you lose your job.
When inflation is higher than the interest a savings account pays, the purchasing power of the balance falls every year.
Central banks raise interest rates to cool an overheating economy.
Treasury inflation-protected securities adjust their principal with the consumer price index, preserving real value.
Buying a home builds equity but adds a down payment, mortgage interest, property taxes and maintenance; renting keeps flexibility and frees cash to invest.
The price-to-rent ratio compares home prices with annual rents, and a high ratio suggests renting is cheaper than owning.
House plants such as pothos and snake plants survive in low light.
Mortgage rates rose sharply in 2023, making monthly payments on new loans more expensive.
